# pantechdynamics_domain_tlds (Data Source)

Lists every top-level domain Pantech sells, with its yearly prices in your organization's currency, in minor units (kobo or cents), before VAT. Registering for n years costs register_minor + renew_minor x (n - 1); a transfer costs transfer_minor + renew_minor x (n - 1).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The TLDs Pantech sells, with yearly prices in minor units.
data "pantechdynamics_domain_tlds" "all" {}

locals {
  com = one([for t in data.pantechdynamics_domain_tlds.all.tlds : t if t.tld == "com"])
}

# Registering example.com for two years costs register + one renewal year.
output "com_two_years_minor" {
  value = local.com.register_minor + local.com.renew_minor
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "domain_tlds".
- `tlds` (Attributes List) The TLDs, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tlds))

<a id="nestedatt--tlds"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tlds`

Read-Only:

- `currency` (String) Currency of the prices: "NGN" or "USD".
- `featured` (Boolean) Whether Pantech features the TLD.
- `privacy_always_on` (Boolean) True when the TLD's registry hides every registrant's contact details itself (.ng and its second levels): privacy is always on and cannot be turned off.
- `register_minor` (Number) Price of the first year of a registration, in minor units.
- `renew_minor` (Number) Price of a renewal year, in minor units.
- `tld` (String) The TLD, without a leading dot, such as "com".
- `transfer_minor` (Number) Price of a transfer to Pantech (which adds one year), in minor units.
